title: Minneapolis Scavenger Hunt Adventure
includes: One scavenger hunts interactive walking activity for your entire group.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be able to walk around 2 miles.
policies: Must have smartphone with cellular data service.
IMPORTANT: Registration Instructions will be found on the Voucher & Email after completing purchase
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Set off on an unforgettable adventure through Minneapolis! Dive into the city’s hidden stories—from its fur-trading roots to its iconic music scene. Take in architectural landmarks like the Foshay Tower and the Target Center as you tackle clever challenges along the way. Discover the tale behind the “Twinkie Law,” explore the beginnings of Mars, Incorporated, and uncover Minneapolis’s leadership in wind energy. Capture fun selfies, hunt for red animals, and even rise like a Phoenix. Adventure is calling Minneapolis is ready when you are!
